description: This file is a device driver implementation for the B91 pin control (pinctrl) in the Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, initialization, and pin configuration functions.

methods.name: pinctrl_b91_init
methods.description: Initializes the pinctrl driver, setting pad multiplexer register from device tree property.

methods.name: pinctrl_configure_pin
methods.description: Configures individual pin settings including function and pull-up resistor.

methods.name: pinctrl_configure_pins
methods.description: Configures multiple pins based on provided pin configuration array.
